origin: https://hub.docker.com/r/vulhub/samba (tag 4.6.3; the Vulhub project image for CVE-2017-7494)

represents: Samba 4.12.2 with SMB1 switched on: outside CVE-2017-7494 (fixed in 4.4.14, 4.5.10, 4.6.4), inside CVE-2021-44142 (fixed in 4.13.17, 4.14.12, 4.15.5)
Samba 4.23.8, default protocol range (SMB 2.0.2 to 3.1.1, no SMB1): outside both CVEs, announces no version over SMB2
the same Samba with `server min protocol = NT1` (SMB1 to 3.1.1) and `server signing = mandatory`: outside both CVEs; SMB1 discloses the version
the same Samba with `server max protocol = SMB2_10`: only SMB 2.0.2 and 2.1
the same Samba with `server min protocol = SMB3_00`: only SMB 3.0, 3.0.2 and 3.1.1
